Keep everything. Finish the interface, the feedback and check the template. Add this section to game_spec.json and use it for every string:
{"text":{"controlsKeyboard":"Left/Right or A/D: run - Space/Up/W: jump (twice for double jump)","controlsTouch":"Left/right buttons: run - Jump button: jump (twice for double jump)","lose":"Game over","win":"All levels cleared!","levelClear":"Level clear!","level":"Level","next":"Next level"}}

HUD (anchored to visible screen edges + safe margin, strings rebuilt only on change)
- Top-left: score (large), lives below as small player-colored squares.
- Top-center: "Level 1/2" (text.level) and level time m:ss.
- Top-right: pause button.
- Bottom: on-screen buttons as surface rounded squares with line outline and arrow / up icons in text color; pressed = line fill.

SCREENS
- Title: attract mode showing level 1, the camera slowly panning from the start up to the goal and back, game title, best score, hints text.controlsKeyboard and text.controlsTouch (highlight the last input type used), text.tapToStart.
- LEVEL_CLEAR: text.levelClear, time, time bonus, button text.next.
- Result: text.lose or text.win, score, best with "New best!", level reached, buttons Play again and Menu.

FEEDBACK (style.feedback, audio.sfx)
- Jump: stretch 0.1 s + action sound. Double jump: 4 particles under the feet + doubleJump.
- Landing (> 300 u/s): squash + 3 dust particles (line color) + land.
- Stomp: enemy flattens (scale y 0.3 for 0.15 s) then bursts, "+100" popup, stomp sound.
- Hurt: flash, screen shake, blink + hit sound.
- Death in pit or spikes: burst at the death position, hit sound, camera snaps to the checkpoint.
- Coin: popup + collect. Checkpoint: ring fills + checkpoint. Goal: positive burst + levelClear.

DEBUG OVERLAY (debug.showFps)
FPS, vx, vy, grounded, jumpsUsed, coyote and buffer timers.

ACCEPTANCE CHECK (fix anything that fails, then report)
1. Run accelerates and decelerates with keys, on-screen buttons (touch and mouse); left + right = stop.
2. Single jump, double jump, short hop on early release; coyote time and jump buffer work and are tunable.
3. No tunneling, no snagging on tile corners; head bumps stop the jump.
4. Pit and spikes cost a life and respawn at the last checkpoint.
5. Patroller turns at walls and edges; stomp kills and bounces; side contact hurts with knockback.
6. Goal -> LEVEL_CLEAR with time bonus -> level 2; goal of level 2 -> win; lives 0 -> lose.
7. Editing a row string changes the level; maxJumps 1 and 3 work.
8. Camera deadzone + lerp, clamped, level centered when the view is larger.
9. Touch: run and jump at the same time; sliding from left to right button switches.
10. Score shown = value sent with sendScore = best saved.
11. Layout correct at 9:32, 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 32:9; full run with keyboard only and touch only.
12. No value hard-coded outside game_spec.json, no console errors, no network requests.
List the game_spec.json keys you added in this step, if any.
